build_asr_pipeline: build a python module to create an automatic speech recognition pipeline using a NeMo ASR model from Hugging Face
run_asr_transcription: run the AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline to transcribe raw audio waveform data into text using a NeMo model
review_asr_model_loading: review the AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline class to understand how it loads and freezes a NeMo ASR model from a Hugging Face repo
refactor_audio_processing: refactor the process_audio_file method to convert stereo audio to monochannel using librosa
summarize_asr_call_method: summarize the __call__ method that transcribes audio by writing a temporary WAV file and calling the NeMo model transcribe function
